thread:
alex: Heads-up — I opened a PR in api that changes the /models/get response shape (adds `runtime_requirements`). https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/402

marta: saw that, thanks. This will affect SDK model typing and console rendering, right?

sam: correct — sdk needs new types + a small mapping layer. I started a draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/57

kim: console will need to show the new runtime hints in the model detail page. I have a branch but waiting on the API PR to land so I can update fixtures. https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/213 (WIP)

ryan: also helm charts need to expose a config flag for runtime selector so runtime can receive the hint via env injection. opened a tiny change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/19

alex: plan: merge order should be api -> sdk -> console -> helm -> runtime. API is breaking for clients, so we need a coordinated rollout window. Agree?

marta: yes. If api is merged first we should cut an sdk release immediately and publish a canary to staging. sdk PR has unit tests but we need integration tests against staging API.

sam: deploying a canary npm tag is easy once api is merged. CI will fail if types mismatch, ci-bot will post status.

ci-bot: api PR #402 — CI: ✅ unit, ✅ integration (staging-mock), ⚠️ end-to-end flaky (1/3).

alex: noted flaky e2e. We'll run the e2e job manually after merge. I can take responsibility for the rollout tomorrow 10:00 PT.

kim: would prefer console changes not merge until sdk release is cut, otherwise console CI breaks. Can we gate console PR on sdk release tag?

sam: yes — I can cut v0.12.0-rc.1 the minute api merge is green. I'll ping here with the tag.

ryan: helm change is non-blocking but needs a small values schema bump. I'll keep it in a separate PR so we can merge after runtime changes land.

marta: runtime team — @ryan, do we need any extra rollout steps? The new hints are advisory but could affect kernel selection logic.

ryan: runtime change is backward-compatible; it will ignore unknown runtime_requirements. But if console toggles a default runtime, we should be careful with canary traffic. I'll coordinate canary routing in staging-1.

alex: checklist for tomorrow 10:00 PT: 1) Merge api PR #402 after manual e2e run, 2) sam cuts sdk v0.12.0-rc.1 and publish canary, 3) update console fixtures and merge console PR, 4) merge helm chart values bump, 5) runtime deploy with canary routing. I'll post a short announcement in #eng-oncall 15m before.

marta: also add a quick integration smoke test in infra-e2e that calls /models/get and asserts `runtime_requirements` presence. I'll open a small PR after api merge.

sam: tagged: v0.12.0-rc.1 — published. SDK CI: all green. Pinging @kim for console preview. :eyes:

kim: preview looks good with rc tag. minor UI tweak in model detail but nothing blocking. I'll merge once I see the final sdk release tag.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: runtime-canary at 2024-07-22T17:15:00Z (staging-1).

alex: thanks everyone. If you need approvals: @marta please approve console, @ryan please approve helm after runtime is stable. I'll handle the api approval after manual e2e.

marta: approved console PR. :shipit:

ryan: will approve helm after verifying canary metrics (latency & error rate).

sam: once api is merged I'll tag final v0.12.0 and notify integrations slack.

alex: wrap-up — we have merge order, someone owns each step, and a canary timeline. ping here if anything blocks before 10:00 PT tomorrow. Thanks!
